title: Behavior Swell
description: Allows the creeper to swell up when a player is nearby. It can only be used by Creepers.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

start_distance.description: Distance in blocks at which the entity starts to swell.

stop_distance.description: Distance in blocks at which the entity stops swelling.
